scope: distinguish ordinary task execution failure from Controller-verified falsification of stable plan assumptions
compute the smallest authorized replan scope from task.dependencies[] only
activate immutable direct N+1 plan revisions while preserving one active revision and historical N audit rows
carry unaffected succeeded work across revisions only when contract, dependency/output, input/source, acceptance-freshness, verification, and unknown-action/process-lease guards remain valid
recover crash-safe supersession without unioning stale N runtime into active N+1

failure_classification_contract.ordinary_execution_failure: compiler/test/runtime/tool/model/resource failures remain execution failures while stable plan assumptions remain valid; retry exhaustion alone never promotes them to plan failure
failure_classification_contract.plan_failure_authority: only Controller-revalidated evidence that falsifies a named stable contract can create plan_failure/stable_contract_invalidated and authorize replan_smallest_scope
failure_classification_contract.forged_or_stale_evidence: free-text/forged contract IDs, missing bounded evidence, unchanged observed fingerprints, stale repository evidence, and caller-only assertions fail closed

smallest_scope_contract.authoritative_graph: task.dependencies[] is the sole hard DAG used for smallest-scope reasoning
smallest_scope_contract.dependency_branch_scope: changed+added branch members may connect additions; unchanged shared upstream ancestors cannot bridge unrelated siblings into the authorized branch
smallest_scope_contract.connected_split_helper: accepted when connected to a retained changed branch node
smallest_scope_contract.full_plan_scope: reserved for verified full-plan invariant invalidation and still subject to Controller evidence revalidation

revision_contract.direct_supersession: N+1 must preserve plan_id, set revision=N+1, supersedes_revision=N, and match the canonical PlanRevisionDiff
revision_contract.one_active: atomic activation marks N superseded and N+1 active in one StateStore transaction before in-memory replacement
revision_contract.history: revision-scoped task/attempt/evidence/output/failure/repair/verification/carry/lineage records preserve N rows rather than deleting or overwriting them
revision_contract.activation_event: plan_revision_activated binds from/to revision and digests, diff/carry/runtime-map digests, execution epoch, repository snapshot/baseline, and plan validity
revision_contract.counter_preservation: unaffected task retry/resource/model counters remain preserved across supersession

carry_forward_contract.initial_success_requires_real_attempt: guarded carry freshness is future reuse policy only; first success still requires a real current attempt and deterministic verification
local_eligibility: previous task carry fingerprint is exact
immutable source-revision verification artifact exists and validates
carry_forward_contract.dependency_closed_n_plus_one: build_superseding_runtime first collects locally eligible candidates, then reaches a fixed point where a task may carry only after every hard upstream has itself actually carried into N+1; carried_task_ids is therefore transitive N+1 dependency closure, not old-N success
carry_forward_contract.source_revision_immutability: carried outputs preserve the immutable N verification record and create N+1 binding/provenance pointing to carried_from_plan_revision/digest rather than fabricating N+1 verification
carry_forward_contract.downstream_readiness: N+1 dependency consumption validates the carried output binding plus N+1 carry fingerprint/provenance; carried task state alone is insufficient
carry_forward_contract.dependency_closed_negative: A carry failure leaves A Planned; a locally eligible dependent B also remains Planned and emits no N+1 carry/output records. The same fixed point prevents transitive descendants from carrying until their upstream chain has actually carried.

replan_budget_and_lineage_contract.stable_scope_lineage: scope lineage fallback hashes plan_id + scope + initial affected task IDs and does not key ceilings on invalidated clause IDs
replan_budget_and_lineage_contract.unrelated_replans: unchanged task lineage is retained so reopen/replan through another clause cannot reset the same scope budget
replan_budget_and_lineage_contract.split_inheritance: changed/added split successors inherit the active scope lineage
replan_budget_and_lineage_contract.ambiguity: multiple inherited lineage IDs fail closed instead of choosing one

unknown_and_process_lease_fence.shared_predicate: activation and recovery use the same process_lease_is_terminal predicate

atomic_recovery_contract.activation_atomicity: N lifecycle supersession, N+1 active document/runtime/attempt/carry/lineage records, active pointer, scope counter, and plan_revision_activated event are persisted transactionally
atomic_recovery_contract.pre_activation_crash: old invalidated/replan-pending state remains recoverable and no half-active N+1 is inferred
atomic_recovery_contract.post_activation_pre_checkpoint: recovery validates the one authoritative N->N+1 activation event plus bound digests and switches to N+1 while retaining N history
atomic_recovery_contract.superseded_checkpoint: trusted N checkpoint cannot become active after valid N+1 activation without explicit carry-forward proof

status_compatibility.pre_plan: durable status/approvals remain read-only and usable before any active compiler plan exists; task/attempt/evidence projections are empty while queued goals/control/actions/approvals remain visible
status_compatibility.active_revision: when an active plan exists, status projects only exact active plan_id/revision/digest rows and durable-pointer/in-memory mismatches fail closed

verification.command: CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true $HOME/.cargo/bin/cargo clippy -p sovereign-plan -p sovereign-controller -p sovereign-eval --all-targets --offline -- -D warnings

verification.detail: workspace-wide; only compiler_real_local_8k_smoke and m1_real_qwen_implementation_repair_restart_qualification remain explicitly ignored local-model gates already handled by prior durable M1 qualification

implementation_worker_report.result: latest dependency-closed carry blocker fixed; no blockers
implementation_worker_report.notes: Separated local carry eligibility from fixed-point N+1 dependency closure; added adversarial A->B carry-failure regression; no evidence/BUILD_STATE/commit changes by worker.

independent_audit.notes: Fresh post-worker-20 exact-tree read-only audit confirmed the prior sole cross-revision carry blocker is fixed; A failure blocks B and transitively C, positive carry/provenance/readiness remain valid, and branch-scope, lineage, lease/recovery, revision-scoped status, pre-plan CLI compatibility, and direct immutable atomic N->N+1 history remain sound.
